name: Database.FlexibleStorage
description:
This service lets other services use a database for simple storage and retrieval needs without requiring any database programming or even the selection of a database to use.

This service will take care of the underlying database storage and retrieval and won’t even require the caller to specify a database account.

A caller can send any “record type” they make up, along with a key and value to add. If needed the service willl generate a simple database table for that record type (plus an associated history table). It’ll then add that data. So, no setup is required to store things.

There’s also an “AccessCode” the caller can use with that record type (like a random string) so that other callers won’t be able to retrieve or update those records unless they know the Access Code.

The caller can choose to indicate IsUserSpecific=True if they want this record to be specific to the current user. For example - if instead of data being shared and remaining accessible across all the organization’s users, the data is user-specific and private.
